name: Pro Schema ERD Viewer
description: Entity-relationship diagram viewer on React Flow: table nodes with typed columns and PK/FK/UQ badges, per-column crow's-foot edges showing cardinality and optionality, in-house layered auto-layout, search-to-focus combobox with upstream/downstream lineage highlighting, minimap and data-driven SVG export. Scales to hundreds of tables.

props.name: tables
props.description: Tables with columns (name, type, pk, fk, nullable, unique, note), optional schema and accent colour

props.name: relations
props.description: Extra or overriding relations (cardinality, optional, label). FK columns produce relations automatically

props.name: onFocusedTableChange
props.description: Fires on click, search, Enter or Escape

props.name: defaultLineageDepth
props.description: Relation hops highlighted from the focused table

props.name: onExportSvg
props.description: Receives the exported SVG; return false to skip the download

props.name: emptyMessage
props.description: Shown when there are no tables

usage: Click a table, pick a search result or press Enter on a focused node to highlight its lineage; Escape or clicking the canvas clears it. Auto-layout re-runs the layered layout; Export SVG downloads a standalone diagram.
